description: Defines the interface IScreenCapture for screen capture functionalities, including methods for uploading and sending screenshots, and an internal notification mechanism.

classes.name: IScreenCapture
classes.description: Interface for screen capture operations, including upload and notification functionalities.

classes.name: IScreenCapture::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface triggered after screen capture upload completion.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for screen capture events.

methods.name: UploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and uploads it to a specified URL.

methods.name: SendScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and uploads it, using a call GUID to identify the request.
